item: Ch7/Ch11 Hospital Financial Stress Test - Act 68 transition scenario (thinnest years FY2027-28)
change: New third mode 'Act 68 Transition FY2026-30' in HospitalFinancialScorecard (/research-lab/policy-quality?tab=scorecard). Per hospital (all 14 GMCB-sourced baselines): FY2025 GMCB actual; FY2026 GMCB projected margin (BMH modeled, unpublished); FY2027 each hospital's GMCB-approved FY27 total NPR change; FY2028 RBP at user-adjustable benchmark (default 200% of Medicare, 250% preset) weighted by each hospital's FY27 commercial share of NPR and applied to price after its FY27 commercial rate change; FY2029-30 revenue growth a user assumption labelled 'global budget rule not published'. Table marks each hospital's minimum-margin year and steepest single-year drop; headline counts hospitals whose drop / low point lands in FY2027-28; system-wide row. Labelled 'Act 68 transition scenario - replace with GMCB rule when published'. At OW defaults (3.5%/5%) the steepest drop lands in FY2028 for 14/14 but the low point is FY2030 because expense outgrows revenue; UI explains this honestly and the FY2029-30 revenue slider shows when FY2027-28 becomes the trough (e.g. 8%/yr -> 14/14 in FY2028). Python replica of the model run before shipping; FY27 NPR rows sum to GMCB's $3,802,585,620 total.
sources: https://gmcboard.vermont.gov/sites/gmcb/files/documents/Press%20Release%20-%20FY27%20Hospital%20Budget%20Review%20Decisions%20-%2009.14.2026%281%29.pdf (GMCB press release Sept 15 2026: commercial rates -2.9% statewide, UVMMC -4.4%, commercial NPR -1.2%, total NPR +1.6%; per-hospital table)
Existing tool data: GMCB FY2025 actuals + FY27 Staff Overview FY26 projections; Oliver Wyman 200%/3.5%/5%

item: Ch14 The Wire - Vermont Legislature health-reform bill tracking ("Bills that would amend Act 68, GMCB appointment changes, and shifts in enforcement posture")
change: New server-side fetcher lib/wire/vt-bills.ts reads public legislature.vermont.gov/bill/status/<session>/<bill> pages for 7 curated 2025-26 bills (S.126/Act 68, S.190 vetoed RBP bill, S.63/Act 62, H.482/Act 49, S.189/Act 146, S.197/Act 173, H.266/Act 55) and parses only act no., title, last recorded action + date. Politeness: robots.txt (Crawl-delay 30; only /bill/load* disallowed, never called) honoured - at most one Legislature request per render and only if the last was >=30s ago; each bill refreshed at most once per 24h; persisted in Supabase ticker_cache id wire_vt_bills with in-process fallback. Failed/changed markup keeps last good status, else shows Status unavailable/pending - see link; nothing invented. VermontBillTracker server component (existing Wire card styling) rendered above the feed on /the-wire. Stale VT Legislature not-connected disclosure removed from /api/wire (UNAVAILABLE_SOURCES now empty; WireFeed hides the block when empty). The Wire tool desc in tools.ts mentions the tracker. Verified 2026-10-09: parser run against all 7 live status pages (31s apart) - all titles/acts match the curated why text. Stress Test Act 68 scenario item re-verified: tsc clean.
